title: AI Photobooth
shortDescription: UI/UX for an AI photobooth kiosk where guests pick a scene, take a photo, and download their AI image by QR code.
longDescription: I designed the complete UI/UX flow for an interactive AI photobooth activation for Abu Dhabi Media Network. Guests start on an attract screen, choose an experience such as Be in Majid, a drama scene poster, or an AI Library template, and then pick a specific style. I designed a guided capture step with a live camera frame, a 3-2-1 countdown, and the option to confirm or retake. While the image is generated, a loading screen keeps guests engaged before the result is revealed in a print-like frame. Guests then scan a QR code to download their image, and a clear error screen with Retry covers failures.
keyFeatures: Three AI experiences: Be in Majid, Drama poster, AI Library
Large image cards built for touch selection
Guided capture with 3-2-1 countdown and retake
Generation loading state and framed result reveal
QR code download with error and retry flow

title: Race The City Game
shortDescription: Complete UI/UX flows for an interactive treadmill racing game built for Dubai CommerCity event activations.
longDescription: I led the design of an immersive interactive gaming experience for Dubai CommerCity's event activations. Attendees play solo or against a second player, entering their details on a tablet before stepping onto a treadmill. They then race a circuit track and follow their progress on an animated wide screen, running through the streets of Dubai. When the race ends, a result screen and a leaderboard are shown. I designed the complete flows in Figma, focusing on engagement, clarity and intuitive navigation for event attendees. I also built a small design system so the tablet and wide-screen interfaces feel like one product.
keyFeatures: Single-player and two-player race modes
Simple tablet registration for each player
Live race screen with progress bars and timers
Winner result screen with a tie state
Leaderboard shown at the end of the race

title: Power Pedal Sprint Game
shortDescription: UI/UX for a two-screen pedal racing game at Dubai CommerCity event activations: tablet registration, live race bars and a leaderboard.
longDescription: I led the UI/UX design of an interactive pedal game for Dubai CommerCity's event activations, working in Figma and Adobe Illustrator. Players choose single or two-player mode and register their details on a tablet. They then pedal to fill their progress bar on an animated wide screen in front of them, where a live bar shows their speed. The quicker player earns the higher position, and a leaderboard closes the experience for the crowd. I designed the full flow across both screens, focusing on clarity, engagement and intuitive navigation for event attendees. I also built a small design system of buttons, input fields, frames and backgrounds so every screen feels consistent.
keyFeatures: Single player and two-player modes
Tablet registration for each player
Clear instructions and 3-2-1-GO countdown
Live progress bars and timer on a wide screen
Results and leaderboard ranked by speed

title: AI Video Station
shortDescription: Touchscreen kiosk where guests act in a drama or step into a TV studio, record with a script, and download an AI video by QR code.
longDescription: I designed the complete UI/UX flows for an interactive AI video station built for an Abu Dhabi Media Network activation. Guests start by choosing where they want to be: acting in a drama scene or appearing in a TV studio. I designed the guided steps that follow, from instructions with a demo video to a 3-2-1 countdown and a recording screen that keeps the script beside the live camera view. After recording, guests watch their AI-generated video, can confirm it or retake it, and scan a QR code to download it. I also built a consistent design system from the network's brand, with warm stone buttons, a camera viewfinder frame and a clear set of icons.
keyFeatures: Two experience paths: Actor or Be in Studio
On-screen script beside the live camera while recording
Virtual news desk overlay for the studio path
Preview with Confirm or Retake before generating the final video
QR code download of the AI-generated video

title: HotPet Dating App
shortDescription: Pet dating app where owners create a profile for their pet, swipe to find compatible playmates, match, and chat to plan playdates.
longDescription:
HotPet helps pet owners find compatible playmates for their pets. I led the project from research to a working app. I surveyed more than 100 pet owners and interviewed 15 of them: 85% were interested in connecting their pets with others, 70% were open to playdates and 58% said their pet feels lonely. I also reviewed competitors such as Paranu and Pawmates. From this I built a user persona and an empathy map, which showed that safety and finding nearby pets that match their own pet's energy were the main concerns.

I then designed the user flows and high-fidelity wireframes, followed by the final UI. Owners sign up by email, phone (with a verification code), Facebook or Google, then set up their pet's profile: species, gender, birthday, photos and a short bio. On the Discover screen they swipe through pet cards, filter by location, age and breed, and get an "It's a match" screen when both sides like each other. Only matched pets can message each other, which keeps conversations safe. I also created the HotPet brand: a logo with a paw-print path between two map pins, a warm green and gold palette, the Nexa typeface, and mockups for merchandise and billboards. The app was built with Swift on the front end and a Node.js and MongoDB back end.
keyFeatures: Swipe-based Discover feed with like, pass and super-like
Mutual match screen with quick "Say Hi" to start chatting
Pet profiles with photo gallery, bio and owner details
Filters by location, age range and breed
Chat limited to matched pets for safer connections
Sign-up by email, phone with code verification, Facebook or Google
Research with 100+ surveyed owners, persona and empathy map
Complete brand identity: logo, palette and Nexa typography

title: Glow Putt Challenge
shortDescription: A light-driven putting game for Emirates NBD event activations, with a bilingual UI flow from welcome sign to live leaderboard.
longDescription: I led the design of Glow Putt Challenge, an immersive interactive putting game for Emirates NBD event activations. Working in Figma, I designed complete UI/UX flows focused on engagement, clarity, and intuitive navigation for event attendees. Players aim for the hole that glows blue: a right hit turns it yellow, a wrong one turns it red, and the lights change faster the better they play. I designed every step of the journey, from the attract screen and personalized welcome sign to the rules, countdown, live score and timer, streak multiplier, and final leaderboard. The whole system works in English and Arabic, with right-to-left layouts and one shared navy-and-glow visual language.
keyFeatures: Color-coded hole lights: blue target, yellow hit, red miss
60-second live score and timer display
Streak multiplier for consecutive correct holes
Personalized welcome sign and result screens
Bilingual English and Arabic leaderboard

title: AI Sketch Activation
shortDescription: Created a user-friendly fitness tracking application with personalized workout recommendations, progress visualization, and community engagement features.
longDescription: I developed a comprehensive fitness tracking mobile application that motivated users to achieve their health goals through engaging design and smart features. The app included workout tracking, progress visualization through charts and metrics, personalized recommendation algorithms, and social features for community engagement. I conducted user testing with fitness enthusiasts to refine the interface and ensure the app was intuitive for users of all technical levels. The design prioritized motivational elements like achievement badges, progress graphs, and personalized encouragement messages. I implemented the app in Flutter to ensure cross-platform compatibility and optimal performance. The app reached 10,000+ downloads and maintained a 4.8-star rating on app stores.
keyFeatures: Real-time workout tracking
Personalized fitness recommendations
Progress visualization and analytics
Social sharing and community features
Wearable device integration support
